triggers.text: Joss says thank you. I can't say it right. So: thank you.
triggers.note: The ending of the missing boy case, Randy's state, and what V saw.

triggers.text: Case file's open if you want to look. No pressure.
triggers.note: The ring case and what is already solved.

triggers.text: I heard it on the scanner. Is that you? Tell me it's not you.
triggers.note: The fight, any witnesses, and V's health.

triggers.text: Joss wants to know if you're coming Sunday. I said I'd ask. So I'm asking.
triggers.note: The dinner and who was there.

triggers.text: You're out near Red Peaks. Come by? Coffee on the stove.
triggers.partnerText: You're out near Red Peaks. Come by? Coffee's on the stove, and I'd like your company.
triggers.note: V's location, and the farm case if RW5 is done.

triggers.text: You alive? I'd check the cameras but I'm trying to be normal.
triggers.partnerText: You alive? I miss you. I'd check the cameras but I'm trying to be normal.
triggers.note: The last topic and any open promise.

triggers.text: Dry gulch off the Red Peaks road. Tin cans, two guns, one bad loser. Me.
triggers.partnerText: Dry gulch off the Red Peaks road. Tin cans, two guns, one bad loser. Me. Come keep me honest.
triggers.note: A shooting range of tin cans in a dry gulch, and River keeps score.

triggers.text: A diner in Santo Domingo. Four witnesses, one stolen tip jar. Come hungry and suspicious.
triggers.partnerText: A diner in Santo Domingo. Four witnesses, one stolen tip jar. Come hungry and suspicious, and sit next to me.
triggers.note: A staged theft at a diner in Santo Domingo, with four witnesses.

triggers.text: Scrapyard south of the city. Five wrecks, one quiz. Loser buys the coffee.
triggers.partnerText: Scrapyard south of the city. Five wrecks, one quiz. Loser buys the coffee. Mostly it's an excuse to spend the afternoon with you.
triggers.note: A wreck field south of the city, with a quiz about the cars.

triggers.text: Badlands west road, a pullout with one tree. Bring something you won't miss and something you will.
triggers.partnerText: Badlands west road, a pullout with one tree. Bring something you won't miss and something you will. Bring yourself too.
triggers.note: A pullout on the Badlands west road where River wants to bury a tin.

triggers.text: Santo Domingo night market. I'll give you an alias. Get a free coffee with it. If you can.
triggers.partnerText: Santo Domingo night market. I'll give you an alias. Get a free coffee with it. If you can. Stay close to me.
triggers.note: A night market in Santo Domingo, where River tests a cover story.
